ios.desc:
The morning before an exam, the first day at a new job, a 6 AM flight. Some mornings you simply can't sleep through.

AlarmK is a mission-based wake-up alarm built on iOS 26 AlarmKit. Because it uses system-level alarms, it rings through Silent and Focus modes. To dismiss it, you complete a mission: scan a QR code by your bathroom door, solve a math problem, or shake the phone. With the QR code or objects away from bed, you must get up.

▶ Why AlarmK
- AlarmKit-based system alarms: same permission model as Apple's Clock app, rings through Silent and Focus
- Mission wake-up: QR/barcode, math, memory, typing, number order, shake, squats, walk, object hunt. 9 missions (chain up to 5, with a practice mode)
- Object hunt: register things around your home, such as the washing machine or kitchen sink, then photograph the ones picked at random when the alarm rings. Checked on your iPhone, never saved
- Deny the system alarm permission and AlarmK won't save an alarm it can't ring. It says why and takes you to Settings
- Wake Report: 7-day wake patterns, mission success rate, streaks

▶ Critical Mode for the mornings that matter
An eight-item night-before checklist: AlarmKit permission, iPhone charging, Silent mode, Focus mode, a saved QR/barcode for this alarm, Apple Watch pairing, a Clock-app backup alarm, and notification permission. iOS gives apps no way to read the ringer switch, and AlarmK doesn't read your Focus status, so those two rows tell you how tomorrow's alarm will be delivered instead. The Clock backup is yours to make. AlarmK never creates one; tick that row once you have. The reliability score counts only rows that settled on a clear pass or fail. Anything not ready says so on the spot.

▶ Live Activity & Dynamic Island
As the alarm gets close, a countdown appears on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. When a mission alarm fires, tap the secondary button to jump straight into it. The same countdown appears in the Apple Watch Smart Stack.

▶ Widgets · Siri · Shift work
- Home and Lock Screen widgets show your next alarm and countdown
- Siri & Shortcuts: set alarms, check the next one, start a nap timer, skip an occurrence, all without opening the app
- Shift rotations (N days on / M days off), optional Korean public-holiday skip, and a fixed-instant option for dated alarms
- An optional bedtime reminder and the wake check guard both ends of the night

▶ iCloud sync
Your alarm definitions sync via your own iCloud (private database). Switch iPho
